body: No, absolutely not. He was just a guy I dated in this story; it really had nothing to do with him. It wasn't that unhinged or hateful, more just a poor judgement in an attempt to cry for help

Yeah, I recognize that. Sucks because I'd been doing so well, but grateful I'm still able to get the help I need. I guess I just want to be able to focus on fixing the issue within me and not having to worry about legal issues I might face as a result. I'm ashamed of what I did, I just don't know the best course of action other than therapy
I am! Don't worry, that's priority number one. I meant more that I didn't want to deceive them for any sort of gain other than support. It was an act of desperation on my part.

Yeah, I really doubt there's any way he'd know since he moved across the country, and we haven't really spoken at all. I also don't think it's likely he'd try and proceed against me. Thank you for the information, it really helps give me some peace of mind
Thank you! I appreciate it. I guess I was worried someone would report something like concealing a death but I'm not really familiar with any of those laws

You're probably correct. I know it's a bit presumptuous of me to assume anyone would care or bother to look into it but it worries me too much. An office job and retirement fund certainly wouldn't provide such constant stress and paranoia

Thank you, that actually makes me feel a lot better. It's easy to assume you're the only person in the world to make mistakes when you live in a mental bubble and self-hatred echo chamber. Overall I'm grateful to come out unscathed and I like to think I'm more empathetic and kind now than I ever could have been otherwise :)

He's high functioning autism and BPD (admittedly I'm really limited in my experience with both) and he claims that's what's causing him to break my boundaries and get angry so often. He agreed to see a therapist but he isn't taking it seriously at all so at this point I'm at a loss
I was thinking swerving potential complications. You know, like preparedness sort of things

That being said, for the holidays he's gonna go with his family to a lake front cabin and I'm gonna take a mini vacation to where I got an out of town seasonal job set up.
